messages:
Morgan: Quick sync 48 4aa pre-launch social run for the webinar (Mar 26). Need captions, assets, routing, and an engagement follow-up plan. Putting a pulse here so Ops + Creative can align.

Anya: TL;DR I can do copy. Need final stat for LinkedIn headline and the shortlink by EOD Mon. Which tone for X? punchy or conversational?

Samir: Creative asks: 1) 1200x628 GIF hero, 1:1 static for LinkedIn, 15s 16:9 clip for thread replies, 9:16 vertical for stories if we repurpose. Can we keep captions under 220 chars for X?

Jamie-bot: Creative request created: CR-5021. Assets assigned to Jamie. ETA Mon 17:00 PT. Progress updates will post here.

Jamie: Confirmed. Will deliver GIF + static + 15s clip by Mon 17:00 PT. Will include a silent caption burn-in option for the clip.

Morgan: Schedule were aiming for (notes):
```
- Tue 11:00 PT (X): teaser GIF + Variant A caption (urgent)
- Tue 12:00 PT (LinkedIn): long-form narrative with benchmark stat + source
- Wed 09:00 PT (X): reminder with shortlink + registration CTA
- Wed 30m prior (X thread): live thread with 3 replies (clip, demo CTA, signup nudge)
- Wed 15m prior (LinkedIn): short reminder post
```

Theo: For tracking: use UTM pattern `?utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=webinar_mar26&utm_content={variant}`. SalesOps, tag leads: `webinar:mar26` and `source:social`. Add `variant={A|B}`.

Riley: Got it. Ill wire UTMs and automate tag creation in SFDC. Will set an initial workflow to assign hot leads to SDR queue for 1-hour follow-up. Also need final registration URL.

Anya: Draft copy (first pass) below. Two X variants + LinkedIn long-form: 
- X Variant A (urgent): "3x faster inference for production apps? See the data. Join our webinar: <shortlink> #inference #LLM"
- X Variant B (conversational): "Want to cut inference cost without sacrificing latency? Well show how. Save your spot: <shortlink>"
- LinkedIn long-form: "Every production LLM team faces the same tradeoffs: latency, cost, and reliability. In our upcoming webinar well walk through real-world benchmarks and the operational levers teams use to hit their SLOs. Register & bring questions: <shortlink>"

Source for stat: pulling from internal benchmark deck (Bench-2026-v3). Will DM citation to Legal.

Samir: Reply thread plan (short):
1) Reply 1 (1m post): "Want the 15s highlight clip? Reply 'clip' and we'll DM it."
2) Reply 2 (5m): "Curious about cost math? Quick breakdown link -> <shortlink>/notes"
3) Reply 3 (15m): "Seats limited. Register now -> <shortlink>"
Also prepare a DM template for people who reply 'clip' so SalesOps can auto-send clip + follow-up link.

Riley: I'll set up the auto-DM flow and include the clip + a one-question qualifier: "Which infra are you on? (cloud/on-prem/mixed)" That'll help SDRs prioritize.

Morgan: Legal check: flag any claims in the LinkedIn copy. @LegalBot can you review the stat when Anya shares it?

LegalBot: Please attach the exact phrasing of the stat + source link. I will review within 4 hours of receipt. If claim requires nuance, Ill suggest language edits.

Anya: Sent stat + source link in DM to LegalBot.

Samir: Small ops note: we should capture thread engagement metrics: replies, link clicks, DMs, and conversion to registration. Theo: can you add `thread_engaged=true` for leads who reply/DM?

Theo: Will add `thread_engaged` flag in routing rules. Also will emit an event to analytics stream so Marketing can see variant performance by click-to-register time.

Jamie: One creative ask  can we test two thumbnail frames for the clip (A: benchmark graph, B: product UI)? Recommend A for LinkedIn and B for X thread.

Morgan: Agree. Let's do that. Jamie: include both thumbnails in deliverable.

Riley: Once assets + final URL arrive, I'll run a smoke test: post to internal preview channel, verify UTMs, tag wiring, and auto-DM. Expect smoke test Mon 18:30 PT.

Morgan: Action items recap: 
- Jamie: deliver assets + thumbnails by Mon 17:00 PT (CR-5021)
- Anya: finalize captions + LinkedIn long-form + stat source by Mon EOD
- Samir: draft reply scripts + DM templates by Mon EOD
- Riley: configure UTMs, SFDC tags, auto-DM workflow + smoke test Mon 18:30 PT
- Theo: add `thread_engaged` flag and analytics event
- LegalBot: review stat once received

Anya: Noted. Ill lock captions A/B and push to this thread when done. :pencil2:

Samir: I'll prepare the clip edits and reply cadence doc and drop in the creative ticket.

Jamie-bot: Reminder: creative check-in Mon 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Morgan: Thanks team. If anything slips, flag here and well adjust cadence. :rocket:
